home_prompt: Use case ui-mockup. Create polished 16:9 Japanese website redesign proposal board for 有限会社トム想野, garden and exterior contractor in Toyohashi Japan. Large desktop home on left, legible narrow mobile home on right showing stacked content with NO horizontal overflow. No invented prices, discounts, testimonials, awards, delivery claims or online booking. Elegant realistic web design not sketch. All Japanese typeset crisply.
